section: Iterate - feature: edit the proposed line before countersigning
title: Countersign logs only the operator line
context: Campaign shadow-proposals-webui W4: countersign moved the whole entry, quotes included, and the operator could not change the wording.
decision: Countersign takes an optional line; a fenced entry is logged as its line only (list item, key marker, block fingerprint), edited or not; the server decides edited; the audit gets edit plus a structured evidence pointer.
consequences: No quote or original wording reaches the log or audit. A stale-view fingerprint is not built (tracked follow-up); a lead can still pre-plant its own audit line.
rationale: Reuses the lock, atomic write and audit of W3; one mirrored grammar rule for line vs quote; the fingerprint keeps crash retry safe without storing text.
rejected: Strip quotes after copying (leak window); hand editing outside the lock; trusting a client edited flag.
